title: Batik Pattern
reference: F1 turn_left F1 turn_right F1 def F1 { forward jump }
hints: The same pattern three times, with turns between.
Teach F1: forward and a jump. Call it between the turns.
F1 turn_left F1 turn_right F1 def F1 { forward jump }

story.intro: PATCH: "The batik gallery: painted cloth, the same pattern over and over. A function is a pattern too, and both bots can share it."
